newsitem.title: USA: IDT Corp names Jim Courter president.
newsitem.headline: IDT Corp names Jim Courter president.

text.p: IDT Corp said Thursday it has named former six-term Republican Congressman Jim Courter as its new president, effective October 1.

The company said upon Courter's appointment as president, IDT founder and Chief Executive Howard Jonas will take on the titles of chairman and CEO, and Howie Balter, IDT chief operating officer, will become vice chairman.

Courter serves on the Advisory Board to the U.S. Export-Import Bank and is a partner at a Washington law firm. The company said he is also a member of IDT's board of directors and is also an original investor in the company.
